cards.title: About KMZ Format
cards.body: KMZ is a compressed version of KML files, used by Google Earth to package geographic data efficiently.

cards.title: About GeoJSON Format
cards.body: GeoJSON is a JSON-based format widely supported by web mapping libraries and modern GIS applications.

cards.title: Why Convert KMZ to GeoJSON?
items: Better support in web mapping libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox)
Easier to parse in JavaScript applications
Use Google Earth data in web applications
Native JSON structure for modern web APIs
